title: TRADE IN THE PICKUP STACK
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text reads like a shooter HUD, short callouts and never an explaining sentence. A sale at the stall said one sentence of up to 135 characters, a purchase said what it cost and where it went in a sentence, the Survivor paying said up to 110 characters, and a gift said Took or Gave in a sentence. They are now rows in the pickup stack: the item tagged where it went, a dim minus row for the price, a green plus row for the sale tagged CARRIED, the Survivor pay and salvage tagged FROM THE SURVIVOR, and a gift tagged FROM or GIVEN TO the teammate. The sale keeps one short line, SOLD 3 ITEMS with what the backpack is worth carried home; the refusal is NOT ENOUGH BANKED CREDITS with the price; a cache he marks is CACHE MARKED. The Credits maths is untouched.
now: Buying, selling, the Survivor pay and gifts show as rows in the pickup stack, with plus and minus money rows.
